title: Adi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [The Arukh, under Nemas](https://www.sefaria.org/Sefer_HeArukh%2C_Letter_Nun.146), cites [Megillah 12b](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.12b.18): “Mordechai was crowned with nimus, like Adi”—that is, like a certain man named Adi, well known in his generation and careful in observing the commandments. [Rashi there](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Megillah.12b.18.1) does not include ke-Adi in his text.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Arukh compares Mordechai with a man named Adi; Hyman reports that Rashi lacks ke-Adi. No new identification of Adi is made.

The linked Arukh quotes כעדי and compares Mordechai’s observance of the Torah to Adi’s. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2831&lang=en) records the variant. The linked Bavli and Rashi omit כעדי, and Rashi explains nimus in terms of names.
